acceptance_criteria.criterion: m2-5-ffmpeg-provisioning.md exists and includes sections for Manifest format, Refresh-pins workflow, and Manual smoke test.
README.md no longer instructs the user to install FFmpeg manually as a prerequisite (or explicitly notes the auto-provisioning behaviour).
The M3 plan's Dependencies section names this milestone (M2.5) as a prerequisite.

summary: All three acceptance criteria satisfied by the WP-010 documentation pass: (1) m2-5-ffmpeg-provisioning.md created with Manifest Format, Refresh-pins workflow (PowerShell/shell commands), offline/mirror instructions, Manual smoke test (9 steps), live download test instructions, and Known Deferred Items table. (2) README.md MainWindowViewModel section updated — shell now documented as starting in ProvisioningTools, not Connecting; no manual ffprobe install instruction present. (3) M3 plan Dependencies section updated to reference M2.5/FfmpegProvisioner as the automatic provisioning source for ffprobe.

comments.note: All three AC were satisfied during the WP-010 documentation pass in the same agent session. WP-012 is a documentation-only WP with no new code changes required.
